correctness.rationale: The proof separately establishes infinite observed sample mean by truncation plus SLLN, exact KS and CvM limits, and conditional refitted-bootstrap degeneration using DKW and a uniform bounded-truncation argument for triangular near-one fitted Pareto shapes. It handles quantifiers for every fixed 0<beta<1 and fixed alpha, including the nonuniform finite-mean neighborhood of beta=1. Exact rational checks at beta=1/2 give KS=1/4, CvM/n=1/30; supplementary checker passed 23 assertions.

originality.rationale: The specific exact fixed-subunit-shape KS/CvM mismatch constants and conditional refitted-bootstrap false-rejection-one theorem are not stated in the read primary materials. The 2022 comparison already warns that moment fitting assumes finite mean and detects nominal-size distortion at beta=1, so the novelty is the quantified 0<beta<1 endpoint law, not discovery of the infinite-mean issue. Prior research-record searches by source, equivalent formulations, broad coverage and precise parameters found no direct theorem; historical-priority risk remains.
residual_risks: The 2022 comparison already explicitly reports shape-one empirical null-size distortion and the finite-mean restriction: the new contribution is narrow and historical priority is not independently certified.
Full text of a relevant Pareto type-I testing thesis could not be inspected, so it cannot be declared noncovering.
A general triangular-array result may imply the conditional bootstrap collapse, even if exact EDF gap constants and full failure statement are not indexed.

value.rationale: A null-model goodness-of-fit test rejecting essentially all genuine heavy-tail null samples is a consequential calibration failure, beyond a generic moment-existence observation. The new exact KS and integrated-squared mismatch constants and conditional-bootstrap proof explain why refitting/re-sampling cannot repair it; applicability is carefully limited to the EDF comparators and fitted-shape convention described in the cited 2023 testing framework.
